content.name: Jennifer Castellanos
content.title: Lead Business Analyst
content.summary: CBAP-certified lead business analyst with 16 years in banking, hospital operations, insurance and utilities. Head a practice of seven analysts at a Central Texas electric utility and led requirements for its $38 million customer billing replacement, delivered with no missed bill cycles at cutover. Strong at process mapping, requirements traceability and getting finance, operations and IT to agree on scope.

experience.title: Lead Business Analyst
bullets: Lead a practice of seven business analysts across billing, field service and outage management, setting standards for user stories, acceptance criteria and traceability.
Owned requirements for a $38 million customer information and billing system replacement covering 610,000 accounts; cutover finished with no missed bill cycles.
Ran 60+ process workshops with call center, meter operations and finance staff, retiring 140 manual workarounds documented in the old system.
Introduced a requirements change board that cut unplanned scope additions by 35% during the build phase.

experience.title: Senior Business Analyst
bullets: Gathered and prioritized requirements for a new commercial auto policy admin platform across 14 states, supporting go-live on schedule.
Modeled the end-to-end quote-to-bind process in BPMN and identified approval steps that added two days; removing them raised quote conversion by 8%.
Wrote 900 test scenarios with QA and led user acceptance testing for 45 underwriters.

experience.title: Business Analyst
bullets: Documented patient registration and scheduling workflows for three hospitals ahead of an EHR upgrade.
Analyzed denied insurance claims and specified front-desk eligibility checks that lowered denials by 13% in the first year.
Built a requirements traceability matrix in Jira and Confluence that became the template for the PMO.

experience.title: Operations Analyst
bullets: Mapped account opening procedures across 22 branches and reduced average opening time from 48 to 31 minutes.
Produced monthly operational risk reports for the compliance committee.
Supported the rollout of online banking enrollment by drafting branch scripts and training materials.
